subtitle: Make offline copies of your online heroes, so you can play them with no ping!
description:
How to use

Open the mod's page in the mod menu to see all your online heroes. Choose Create Offline Copy on a hero to make a new offline hero with the same level, gear and progress. Your online hero is not changed.

Why no offline to online?

Online heroes don't live on your PC. They're stored on Mojang's servers, and when you play one, Mojang's game server loads and saves it, not your game. Your game only gets a read-only link to download a copy of the save, which is how this mod makes offline copies.

Turning an offline hero into an online one would mean writing a save to the server. Only Mojang's game servers can do that, using a login your game never has. Your game can create a new online hero, but the server always starts it from a fresh save, and the game has no way to send it yours. Offline heroes can be backed up to the cloud, but they stay offline heroes.

So online copies of offline heroes aren't possible with a mod.

Requirements

  • Native Loader, which loads this mod's DLL
  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the HeroConverter folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\HeroConverter\HeroConverter_P.pak

If it doesn't work

If the mod doesn't work for you, make an empty file called console, with no file extension, inside the HeroConverter folder in ~mods. A console window opens with the game and shows what the mod is doing. Try again, then press Copy all in the console and send me what it says on Discord.

Uninstall

Delete the HeroConverter folder from ~mods.
